name: Ippai Shimasho
source:
Main character is asked to replace his younger sister in a girl university. It's embarrassing, but it is also such a chance! Now he can freely enter skinship relations with girls and maybe learn their weaknesses to get to know them closer.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公受人所托，要代替妹妹进入一所女子大学。虽然令人难为情，但这也是千载难逢的机会！现在他可以自由地和女孩们亲密接触，甚至还能探听她们的弱点，借此进一步了解她们。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
